scope: Guarded matched-runner comparison of three admitted runtime profiles and source versus each profile’s own FAS. Fresh browser/profile per pair, then same-page/context reload after confirmed old CAS and probe-worker termination. Fresh probe/session/buffers on every measurement; same explicitly derived stdout-only child observer in all six cells and every restart. Original startup/session/runtime bytes unchanged. These are guarded timings, not pristine-wrapper timings; marker parsing/one bounded receipt add shared overhead. No TRACE, CPU profiler or FS observer. Existing marker order and no matched fatal do not prove a same-evaluation root-load return. Warm calls reuse that measurement’s worker. Rotating order limits but does not remove cache/runner variation. n3 medians are descriptive, not a statistical speedup or default promotion. Combined readiness/logical/positive is a synthetic sum of measured blocks, not complete UI latency.
